update_message:
What's New in 2.1.1:

🎨 Complete Modern UI Redesign
• New glassmorphism and neumorphic card styles
• Animated tabs, search bar, and list items
• Beautiful now playing screen with rotating album art
• Modern mini player with gradient progress bar

🎨 New Theme System
• 10 accent color presets (Teal, Ocean, Purple, Rose, Amber, Emerald, Coral, Indigo, Crimson, Mint)
• 4 dark variants (Midnight, Charcoal, Navy, AMOLED)
• Pure black AMOLED mode
• Adjustable contrast levels

✨ Smooth Animations Everywhere
• Staggered list animations
• Animated toggle switches
• Pulse and wave loading indicators
• Skeleton loaders

🔧 Bug Fixes
• Fixed MissingPluginException on startup
• Improved round icon support for launchers
